title: AES/ECB mode used in seal() and open(); no authenticated encryption
detail: src/aurora/aurora-identity/src/main/java/cloud/aurora/identity/CryptoUtil.java:L19 (seal) and L25 (open) both call Cipher.getInstance("AES/ECB/PKCS5Padding"); ECB mode produces identical ciphertext for identical plaintext blocks, enabling block-pattern analysis and replay; no integrity protection is provided.
